QuestionStmt.S: Which from following gases is adsorbed to greater extent if adsorbent remains same at similar conditions of temperature and pressure?

Solution.S:
Gases having high critical temperature liquify easily and can readily be adsorbed.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Gas} & \text{Critical Temperature} \\
\hline
O_2 & 154.3 \text{ K} \\
SO_2 & 430.0 \text{ K} \\
N_2 & 126.0 \text{ K} \\
H_2 & 33.2 \text{ K} \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

$SO_2$ has the highest critical temperature (430 K), so it is adsorbed to the greatest extent. Hence the correct option is B: $SO_2$.
